safe_diy_checks.title: Acoustic Stethoscope Screwdriver Test
steps: Place the tip of a long screwdriver securely against the cylinder head tappet inspection cap and hold the plastic handle to your ear.

safe_diy_checks.safety_precaution: Keep loose clothing and hair completely clear of moving drive components.

professional_mechanic_checks.title: Feeler Gauge Valve Clearance Calibration
steps: Rotate crankshaft to Top Dead Center (TDC) on compression stroke aligning flywheel 'T' mark.
Insert feeler gauge blade between valve tip and rocker arm; set strictly to OEM factory spec (e.g., 0.08mm intake, 0.12mm exhaust).
professional_mechanic_checks.safety_precaution: Engine must be completely cold (under 35°C) for accurate lash measurement.

clarifying_questions: Is the ticking metallic sound louder when the engine is dead cold or after warming up?

model_specific_notes: Royal Enfield Classic/Hunter/Meteor 350 (J-Series engine): Uses overhead cam (OHC) with hydraulic valve lifters requiring no manual tappet adjustments, unlike older UCE pushrod engines.

safe_diy_checks.title: Standstill Judder Test
steps: Put scooter on main stand.
Sit on the scooter, apply both brakes lightly, and give very gentle throttle.

safe_diy_checks.safety_precaution: Hold brakes firmly to prevent vehicle jumping forward.

professional_mechanic_checks.title: CVT Pulley Disassembly & Belt Width Measurement

Deglaze clutch bell inner contact drum using 120-grit emery paper.
professional_mechanic_checks.safety_precaution: Wear face dust mask to avoid inhaling hazardous clutch friction dust.

clarifying_questions: Does the shudder or vibration happen strictly when moving from dead stop (0–20 km/h)?
Has the scooter CVT cover been cleaned in the last 6,000 km?

estimated_repair_cost.notes: CVT case cleaning, clutch shoe deglazing with emery sheet
